verdict.rationale: Docs mention a 'managed connector framework' letting Computer connect to 400+ services via one-click OAuth, which implies some connector directory/management capability, but there is no evidence of a user-facing browsable directory of third-party apps within the core assistant UI, nor confirmation this is exposed to all power-users rather than just the Computer/agent product. Missing for 10: explicit UI screenshots or docs showing a searchable/browsable connector directory in the main Perplexity assistant, confirmation of add/remove flow, and independent corroboration of the 400+ services claim.
